verdict.rationale: Chroma offers two documented ways to test in isolation from production. The CLI and the OSS server let you run Chroma locally or self-hosted. Chroma Cloud's copy-on-write collection forking is pitched for dataset versioning and A/B testing, so you can experiment on a fork while the original stays untouched, and a community user independently confirms the forking works. Missing for 10: no explicit sandbox or staging-environment documentation, no separate test-mode credentials or projects, and no hands-on evidence that writes to a fork never affect the source collection.
